info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Loyalty Loyalty Transfer-v5-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Transfer Management API facilitates the seamless transfer of loyalty points between customers. This endpoint allows businesses to manage loyalty points efficiently, ensuring that customers can transfer their rewards as needed. The primary users of this API are customer service representatives and application developers who are enhancing customer engagement features. Through this API, companies can improve customer satisfaction by enabling flexibility in loyalty point usage among customers.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to transfer loyalty points from one account to another. Ensure that the sender has enough points available for the transfer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to transfer loyalty points from one account to another. It contains the necessary details for the transfer, ensuring both sender and recipient accounts are defined, along with the amount of points to be transferred.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the transfer operation was successful.

ReplaceLoyaltyLoyaltyTransferRequest.title: Loyalty Transfer Request

priority.description: Priority level of the request, a higher number may indicate higher urgency.

amount.description: Amount of loyalty points or currency to be transferred.

currency.description: Currency type for the transfer, if applicable.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if a notification should be sent after the transfer is completed.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the transfer request was made.

channel.description: Channel through which the transfer was requested, e.g., mobile app or website.

recordIndex.description: Index of the record associated with the transfer request.
